# Code of Conduct

## Standards & Expectations

AGYOS maintains an open, respectful, and professional environment. All participants, contributors, and maintainers are expected to:

- Demonstrate empathy and kindness toward all community members.
- Provide and accept constructive technical feedback gracefully.
- Focus on what is best for the project, users, and overall software quality.
- Respect differing perspectives and technical viewpoints.

## Unacceptable Behavior

Harassment, derogatory language, personal attacks, or unprofessional conduct will not be tolerated.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers reserve the right to remove or moderate comments, commits, code, and issues that violate these standards.
